1.web: To you, Yahweh, do I lift up my soul.
1.asv: Unto thee, O Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.

2.web: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
2.asv: O my God, in thee have I trusted, Let me not be put to shame; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.

3.web: Yes, no one who waits for you shall be shamed. They shall be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
3.asv: Yea, none that wait for thee shall be put to shame: They shall be put to shame that deal treacherously without cause.

4.web: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
4.asv: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths.

5.web: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
5.asv: Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.

6.web: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
6.asv: Remember, O Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindness; For they have been ever of old.

7.web: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
7.asv: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy lovingkindness remember thou me, For thy goodness’ sake, O Jehovah.

8.web: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
8.asv: Good and upright is Jehovah: Therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.

9.web: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
9.asv: The meek will he guide in justice; And the meek will he teach his way.

10.web: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
10.asv: All the paths of Jehovah are lovingkindness and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

11.web: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
11.asv: For thy name’s sake, O Jehovah, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.

12.web: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
12.asv: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? Him shall he instruct in the way that he shall choose.

13.web: His soul shall dwell at ease. His seed shall inherit the land.
13.asv: His soul shall dwell at ease; And his seed shall inherit the land.

14.web: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
14.asv: The friendship of Jehovah is with them that fear him; And he will show them his covenant.

15.web: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
15.asv: Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; For he will pluck my feet out of the net.

16.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
16.asv: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted.

17.web: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
17.asv: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: Oh bring thou me out of my distresses.

18.web: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
18.asv: Consider mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.

19.web: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
19.asv: Consider mine enemies, for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.

20.web: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
20.asv: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me: Let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in thee.

21.web: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
21.asv: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for thee.

22.web: Redeem Israel, God, out all of his troubles.
22.asv: Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all his troubles.
